# NOAA/NCEI World Magnetic Model 2025

This directory vendors the official WMM2025 coefficient file used to generate
Aerobag magnetic-variation grid entries.

Source:
- NOAA/NCEI World Magnetic Model coefficients page:
  https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/world-magnetic-model/wmm-coefficients
- Download URL used:
  https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/WMM2025COF.zip

Upstream metadata:
- Model: WMM-2025
- Model epoch: 2025.0
- Coefficient release date in `WMM.COF`: 11/13/2024
- NOAA package README date: December 17, 2024
- Valid model window: 2025.0 through 2030.0

NOAA's WMM page states that the WMM source code is public domain and that WMM
model values should be cited as:

NOAA NCEI Geomagnetic Modeling Team; British Geological Survey. 2024: World
Magnetic Model 2025. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
https://doi.org/10.25921/aqfd-sd83.
